insights.headline: Comments are more negative than positive overall (635 negative, 499 positive of 1,441), and 14 possible safety reports need a person to read them today.

points.text: Battery issues have 296 comments (20.5% of all), 78.0% negative, 17.6% positive, impact score 459.9. Negative comments are rising.
Battery issues negative comments per day rose from 7.0 to 12.7 per day, peaking at 22 on 2026-09-24.
The top negative reasons for battery issues are 'battery drains fast' (47 comments) and 'battery dies quickly' (29 comments).
The most engaged negative comments mention battery swelling, overheating during charging, and battery failure after an update.

actions.action: Have a person read these safety reports now, escalate any that are real, and contact those customers.
